name: Quick Study (Shaping)
description: Shaping comes easily; you master shaped effects faster than your peers.

name: Bookish
description: Raised among books. Learns history and theory quickly, and starts as a Scholar.

name: Mana-Sensitive
description: Born with an unusual feel for mana; your sense of it sharpens far faster than normal.

name: Born to Fire
description: Raw talent for flame that unsettles the faculty.

name: Trained Duelist
description: Trained to fight early. May duel formally, and can Brace in combat.
